I have a shortlist on Letterboxd of directors I haven’t seen a film from. Are the films I’ve picked out the best starting points for each?
I would say *All That Jazz* for Fosse, just because it's (in my opinion, and Stanley Kubrick's) a truly great, mindblowing film.
I would do “A Place in the Sun” for George Stevens

I was watching Tarkovsky's Mirror w/ some buddies last night, and one of them came up with the idea for this:


https://www.instagram.com/reel/C8MmVM5OJ5F/?igsh=MWVveWV1cDhzMzY4Nw==

I know Michael Bay has always cut fast and moves his camera a lot, but in Ambulance (2022) it borders on abstract. At times it's straight up incomprehensible what's going on.

He makes Greengrass feel like a very sedate Bergman.
